# Deploy to Vercel

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Build and deploy a project to Vercel (preview or production) via the Vercel CLI

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/deploy-vercel@v1
  with:
    vercel-token: # Vercel access token (Account Settings → Tokens).
    vercel-org-id: # Vercel organization/team ID (`VERCEL_ORG_ID`).
    vercel-project-id: # Vercel project ID (`VERCEL_PROJECT_ID`).
```

## How it works

Deploy to Vercel through the official CLI.

The CLI rather than a third-party wrapper action, because the wrappers lag behind Vercel's
release cadence and hide the `pull → build → deploy --prebuilt` flow that makes builds
reproducible. Building in the runner (not on Vercel's builders) means the deployment ships
exactly the artifact CI just tested, and build failures surface as job failures with real
logs.

Preview vs production is one input. Preview deployments are the default so that wiring
this into a PR workflow is safe by accident rather than dangerous by accident.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vercel-token` | **yes** | — | Vercel access token (Account Settings → Tokens). |
| `vercel-org-id` | **yes** | — | Vercel organization/team ID (`VERCEL_ORG_ID`). |
| `vercel-project-id` | **yes** | — | Vercel project ID (`VERCEL_PROJECT_ID`). |
| `environment` | no | `preview` | preview \| production |
| `working-directory` | no | `.` | Directory containing the Vercel project. |
| `prebuilt` | no | `true` | `true` builds in the runner and uploads the output (reproducible, recommended). `false` uploads sources and lets Vercel build. |
| `build-env` | no | `""` | Newline-separated `KEY=value` pairs exported before `vercel build`. |
| `alias` | no | `""` | Comma-separated domains to alias the deployment to after a successful deploy. |
| `vercel-version` | no | `latest` | Version of the Vercel CLI to install. |
| `deploy-args` | no | `""` | Extra args appended to `vercel deploy`. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `url` | The deployment URL. |
| `inspect-url` | Vercel dashboard URL for the deployment. |
| `environment` | The environment that was deployed to. |
